model_annotation:
This figure contains two line plots stacked vertically, both sharing the same x-axis labeled "Steps" and appearing to track a performance metric on the y-axis (though the y-axis label is not visible). The x-axes appear to use a linear scale, and neither plot displays explicit tick labels for the axes, making precise numerical values difficult to determine. The top plot is unlabeled but implicitly corresponds to an "Easy Training Set" given the legend entries and the explicit title "Hard Training Set" on the bottom plot.

In the top plot, two lines are shown: a blue line labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" and a red line labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Easy." Both lines are solid and accompanied by shaded regions indicating variability or confidence intervals. The blue line starts at a lower value on the left side of the plot and rises steeply in the early steps before leveling off and fluctuating at a relatively high plateau through the remainder of the x-axis. The red line begins at a similar or slightly higher value than the blue line at the leftmost point, rises more gradually, and also reaches a high plateau region, with both lines occupying a similar range in the latter portion of the plot. The blue line appears to reach its plateau earlier than the red line.

In the bottom plot, titled "Hard Training Set," two lines are shown: a blue line labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" and a red line labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Hard," both solid with shaded confidence regions. The blue line starts at a low value and increases gradually across the steps, showing a relatively steady upward trend throughout. The red line also starts at a low value and increases across the steps, with a notably steeper rise in the later portion of the x-axis, reaching values that appear higher than the blue line toward the rightmost end of the plot. Both lines exhibit fluctuations throughout, and the red line's shaded region appears somewhat wider than the blue line's in the later steps.
